'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Noah Dockendorf LS Rescue The Princess''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Noah Dockendorf]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Rescue the Princess
* '''Username:''' An_Idea
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
